answer: A Registered domain bound by DNS record proof with a public binding record ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the registered domain answers a fresh challenge, the DNS record proof is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A lone ocean cannot fake a channel; only the bound record counts. A umber alone is noise; a reef of verified channels is a pattern the network can trust.
